definitions.name: Bard
definitions.summary: Musician and spellcaster who inspires allies and knows a little of everything.

definitions.name: Additional Bard Spells
definitions.summary: Optional (Tasha's): extra spells are added to the bard spell list (see the book's list).

definitions.name: Magical Inspiration
definitions.summary: Optional (Tasha's): a creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can add it to one healing roll or one damage roll of a spell it casts, then the die is spent.

definitions.name: Bardic Versatility
definitions.summary: Optional (Tasha's): whenever you get an Ability Score Improvement, you may swap one Expertise skill for another proficient skill, or one bard cantrip for another.

definitions.name: College of Valor
definitions.summary: Battle-ready bard whose inspiration also boosts damage and defense.

definitions.name: Bonus Proficiencies
definitions.summary: Proficiency with medium armor, shields and martial weapons.

definitions.name: Combat Inspiration
definitions.summary: A creature with your Bardic Inspiration die can also add it to a weapon damage roll, or to its AC as a reaction against one attack.

definitions.name: Extra Attack
definitions.summary: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

definitions.name: Battle Magic
definitions.summary: After using your action to cast a bard spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

actions.name: Battle Magic
actions.note: After casting a bard spell with your action: one weapon attack as a bonus action.

definitions.name: College of Glamour
definitions.summary: Fey-touched bard who beguiles crowds and commands with majesty.

definitions.name: Mantle of Inspiration
definitions.summary: Bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration: up to Charisma modifier (min 1) creatures within 60 ft gain temp HP (5, rising to 14 at 15th) and can use their reaction to move without provoking opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Mantle of Inspiration

roll.label: temp HP for each chosen creature

actions.note: Up to Cha mod creatures within 60 ft: temp HP, and each may move its speed with its reaction without provoking.

definitions.name: Enthralling Performance
definitions.summary: After performing for at least 1 minute, up to Charisma modifier humanoids that watched make a Wisdom save or are charmed by you for an hour. Once per short or long rest.

actions.name: Enthralling Performance
actions.note: After a 1-minute performance: Wisdom save or charmed for 1 hour.

definitions.name: Mantle of Majesty
definitions.summary: Bonus action: for 1 minute (concentration) you can cast Command as a bonus action each turn without a slot; charmed targets fail automatically. Once per long rest, or spend a 3rd-level or higher slot.

actions.name: Mantle of Majesty
actions.note: Concentration, 1 minute. Cast Command as a bonus action each turn, no slot.

definitions.name: Unbreakable Majesty
definitions.summary: Bonus action, 1 minute: a creature attacking you for the first time on a turn must make a Charisma save or pick a new target; on a success it has disadvantage on saves against your spells on your next turn. Once per short or long rest.

actions.name: Unbreakable Majesty
actions.note: First attack against you each turn: Charisma save or retarget.

definitions.name: College of Swords
definitions.summary: Blade-juggling bard who spends inspiration on weapon flourishes.

definitions.name: Bonus Proficiencies
definitions.summary: Proficiency with medium armor and the scimitar; a proficient simple or martial melee weapon can be your spellcasting focus.

definitions.name: Fighting Style
definitions.summary: Pick Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting.

definitions.name: Blade Flourish
definitions.summary: When you take the Attack action, your walking speed rises by 10 ft until the end of the turn. Once per turn on a weapon hit, spend a Bardic Inspiration for a flourish (a tick-box on the damage roll): Defensive (the die to damage and to your AC until your next turn), Slashing (the die to the target and to another creature within 5 ft of you), or Mobile (the die to damage and push the target 5 ft + the die).

table: d6
d8

when.text: once per turn, on a weapon hit during the Attack action: the die is added to the damage and to your AC until the start of your next turn; spends a Bardic Inspiration
once per turn, on a weapon hit during the Attack action: the die is added to the damage, and another creature of your choice within 5 ft of you takes the same amount; spends a Bardic Inspiration

once per turn, on a weapon hit during the Attack action: the die is added to the damage, and you can push the target 5 ft + the die away; your reaction can then take you up to your walking speed to a space within 5 ft of it; spends a Bardic Inspiration

actions.name: Blade Flourish
actions.note: Once per turn, on a weapon hit during the Attack action. The flourishes are also tick-boxes on your weapon damage roll, with the die added there.

definitions.name: Extra Attack
definitions.summary: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

definitions.name: Master's Flourish
definitions.summary: When you flourish, you can roll a d6 instead of spending a Bardic Inspiration.

when.text: once per turn, on a weapon hit during the Attack action: the d6 is added to the damage and to your AC until the start of your next turn; a d6 instead of a Bardic Inspiration

once per turn, on a weapon hit during the Attack action: the d6 is added to the damage, and another creature of your choice within 5 ft of you takes the same amount; a d6 instead of a Bardic Inspiration

once per turn, on a weapon hit during the Attack action: the d6 is added to the damage, and you can push the target 5 ft + the d6 away; your reaction can then take you up to your walking speed to a space within 5 ft of it; a d6 instead of a Bardic Inspiration

actions.name: Master's Flourish
actions.note: A flourish using a d6 instead of a Bardic Inspiration (still once per turn). The flourishes are also tick-boxes on your weapon damage roll, with the die added there.

definitions.name: College of Whispers
definitions.summary: Bard of secrets, fear and stolen identities.

definitions.name: Psychic Blades
definitions.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, spend a Bardic Inspiration for extra psychic damage (2d6; 3d6 at 5th, 5d6 at 10th, 8d6 at 15th).

actions.name: Psychic Blades
actions.note: Once per turn, after hitting with a weapon.

definitions.name: Words of Terror
definitions.summary: After a 1-minute private talk, the creature makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you or a creature you choose for 1 hour. Once per short or long rest.

actions.name: Words of Terror
actions.note: After 1 minute speaking alone with it: Wisdom save or frightened for 1 hour.

definitions.name: Mantle of Whispers
definitions.summary: Reaction when a humanoid dies within 30 ft: capture its shadow, then use an action to take on its appearance for 1 hour and gain a sense of its memories. Once per short or long rest.

actions.name: Mantle of Whispers
actions.note: Capture a dying humanoid's shadow; disguise as it for 1 hour (+5 Deception to pass as it).

definitions.name: Shadow Lore
definitions.summary: Action: whisper to a creature within 30 ft; on a failed Wisdom save it's charmed and obeys you for 8 hours, believing you know its deepest secret. Once per long rest.

actions.name: Shadow Lore
actions.note: Wisdom save or charmed for 8 hours.

definitions.name: College of Creation
definitions.summary: Bard who sings objects into being and animates them.

definitions.name: Mote of Potential
definitions.summary: Your Bardic Inspiration dice gain a bonus: on a check, roll the die twice and take either; on an attack, a hit sends a thunder burst (Con save) around the target; on a save, the creature also gains temp HP equal to the roll + your Charisma modifier.

definitions.name: Performance of Creation
definitions.summary: Action: create a nonmagical item worth up to 20 gp x bard level (Medium; Large at 6th, Huge at 14th) that lasts proficiency bonus hours. Once per long rest, or spend a 2nd-level or higher slot.

actions.name: Performance of Creation
actions.note: Create an item worth up to 20 gp x bard level; lasts proficiency bonus hours. Or spend a 2nd+ slot instead.

definitions.name: Animating Performance
definitions.summary: Action: animate a Large or smaller nonmagical item within 30 ft as a Dancing Item for 1 hour. It acts on your turn; command it with a bonus action. Once per long rest, or spend a 3rd-level or higher slot.

actions.name: Animating Performance
actions.note: Animate an item for 1 hour. Or spend a 3rd+ slot instead.

companions.name: Dancing Item
companions.combatNote: Shares your initiative and acts right after you. It Dodges unless you use a bonus action to command it. You can also have it use its reaction when you use Bardic Inspiration.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.summary: Immune to anything that would change its shape.

traits.name: Irrepressible Dance
traits.summary: A creature starting its turn within 10 ft of it can have its speed raised or lowered by 10 ft that turn (the item chooses).

traits.name: Immunities
traits.summary: Immune to poison and psychic damage, and to being charmed, exhausted, frightened or poisoned.

definitions.name: Creative Crescendo
definitions.summary: Performance of Creation can make several items at once (up to your Charisma modifier, min 2); one may be any size within the limits, the rest Small or smaller, and there's no gold limit.

definitions.name: College of Eloquence
definitions.summary: Master orator whose words persuade, unsettle and inspire.

definitions.name: Silver Tongue
definitions.summary: Treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 on Persuasion and Deception checks.

definitions.name: Unsettling Words
definitions.summary: Bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration: roll the die; a creature within 60 ft subtracts it from its next saving throw before your next turn.

table: d6
d8

actions.name: Unsettling Words
actions.note: A creature within 60 ft you can see; lasts until the start of your next turn.

definitions.name: Unfailing Inspiration
definitions.summary: If a creature adds your Bardic Inspiration die to a roll and still fails, it keeps the die.

definitions.name: Universal Speech
definitions.summary: Action: up to Charisma modifier (min 1) creatures within 60 ft understand you for 1 hour regardless of language. Once per long rest, or spend any spell slot.

actions.name: Universal Speech
actions.note: Chosen creatures understand you for 1 hour. Or spend a spell slot instead.

definitions.name: Infectious Inspiration
definitions.summary: Reaction when a creature succeeds on a roll using your Bardic Inspiration: give a free Bardic Inspiration to another creature within 60 ft. Charisma modifier (min 1) uses per long rest.

actions.name: Infectious Inspiration
actions.note: After a creature succeeds with your Bardic Inspiration: another creature within 60 ft gets one without spending your uses.

definitions.name: College of Spirits
definitions.summary: Bard who channels spirits through occult tools, telling their tales to change the world.

definitions.name: Guiding Whispers
definitions.summary: You learn guidance, without it counting among your cantrips; your guidance reaches 60 ft.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.casting: a bard cantrip that isn't counted; range 60 ft for you

definitions.name: Spiritual Focus
definitions.summary: A candle, crystal ball, skull, spirit board or tarokka deck is your spellcasting focus. From 6th level, a bard spell cast through it that deals damage or heals adds 1d6 to one of its rolls.

when.text: a bard spell cast through your Spiritual Focus: one of its damage rolls
a bard spell cast through your Spiritual Focus: one of its healing rolls

definitions.name: Tales from Beyond
definitions.summary: Holding your Spiritual Focus, a bonus action and a Bardic Inspiration use: roll your Bardic Inspiration die on the Spirit Tales table. An action later bestows that tale on a creature within 30 ft (you too). One tale at a time; it fades on a short or long rest. Saves use your spell save DC.

actions.name: Tales from Beyond: a tale

roll.label: the tale the spirits tell
table: 1 · Clever Animal: for 10 minutes, the target adds your Bardic Inspiration die to its Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma checks (rolled after the d20).
2 · Renowned Duelist: your melee spell attack against the target; a hit deals force damage of two of your Bardic Inspiration dice + your Charisma modifier.
3 · Beloved Friends: the target and one creature it picks within 5 ft gain temporary hit points of your Bardic Inspiration die + your Charisma modifier.
4 · Runaway: the target teleports up to 30 ft with its reaction; up to your Charisma modifier of creatures it sees within 30 ft may do the same with theirs.
5 · Avenger: for 1 minute, a creature that hits the target in melee takes force damage of your Bardic Inspiration die.
6 · Traveler: temporary hit points of your Bardic Inspiration die + your bard level; while they last, +10 ft walking speed and +1 AC.
7 · Beguiler: Wisdom save or psychic damage of two of your Bardic Inspiration dice and incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
8 · Phantom: invisible until the end of its next turn or its first hit; that hit adds necrotic damage of your Bardic Inspiration die and frightens the creature hit until the end of its next turn.
9 · Brute: creatures of its choice within 30 ft make a Strength save: thunder damage of three of your Bardic Inspiration dice and prone, or half and standing.
10 · Dragon: a 30-ft cone of fire from its mouth: Dexterity save, fire damage of four of your Bardic Inspiration dice, half on a success.
11 · Angel: it regains hit points of two of your Bardic Inspiration dice + your Charisma modifier, and one of blinded, deafened, paralyzed, petrified or poisoned ends.
12 · Mind-Bender: Intelligence save or psychic damage of three of your Bardic Inspiration dice and stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.note: Keep it in mind until you bestow it or rest; a new roll replaces it. Saves: {spelldc}.

actions.name: Tales from Beyond: bestow it

roll.label: one Bardic Inspiration die for the tale (roll it as many times as the tale says)

actions.note: One creature you can see within 30 ft, you too. Saves: {spelldc}.

definitions.name: Spirit Session
definitions.summary: Once per long rest, an hour-long ritual (it can be part of a rest) with up to your proficiency bonus of willing creatures, you included: until your next long rest you know one divination or necromancy spell from any class, of a level up to the number of participants that you can cast. It counts as a bard spell, not among your spells known.

actions.name: Spirit Session
actions.note: One hour with up to {pb} willing creatures. Pick the spell in Choices: its level can't be higher than how many took part. You know it until your next long rest.

definitions.name: Mystical Connection
definitions.summary: When you roll on the Spirit Tales table, roll twice and pick either tale; doubles let you pick any tale.

actions.name: Mystical Connection: the second roll

roll.label: the second tale: keep either (the same number twice: any tale)
